verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch documents built-in AI-powered features that do specific tasks inside the product: renaming requests, generating structured payloads, and writing pre-request scripts and test cases. These are scoped feature-level helpers, not a general assistant you can hand open-ended tasks to. The MCP server serves external agents, so it does not count as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: a general conversational or agentic in-product assistant that accepts arbitrary delegated tasks, multi-step task execution, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Use AI-powered features in Hoppscotch to rename requests, generate payloads, and write pre-request scripts and test cases automatically.
These include renaming of API requests, generation of structured request payloads, and scripting capabilities for pre-request logic and test cases.
